description: DailyHero helps parents use ChatGPT to understand family task progress, points, rewards, and recent activity, then create parent-managed tasks and rewards for their children. It can read DailyHero family data and create tasks or rewards when the parent grants create access. It cannot approve task completions, redeem rewards, change points directly, manage child profiles, or perform account and privacy actions.
